scope: Different-author, source-only hammer of M2009. Official and independent regressions ran under CPython 3.6 and 3.12. Executable mutations were confined to TemporaryDirectory namespaces. No production process capture, archive, canonical shard/payload namespace, merge, reducer, GPU, or EDA was opened or executed.

p1.finding: _promote_result_resumable safely promotes a completely copied and sealed <result>.m2009_import_work tree, but a normal crash during shutil.copytree leaves an incomplete directory at that fixed name. Every later manual resume enters verify_sealed_tree on the same incomplete directory and rejects it again. The independent TemporaryDirectory regression reproduced two consecutive failures with the orphan preserved and no target published.
p1.impact: M2007's original interrupted-mid-copy transaction remains unrecoverable. A valid sealed plan and immutable staging tree cannot restart the sole manual-resume path after this ordinary crash point.
p1.required_repair: An additive successor must distinguish a fully sealed plan-matching orphan from an incomplete orphan. Keep the former promotable; atomically quarantine the latter with renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE), preserve its evidence, then copy the already reverified staged tree into a fresh exclusive work name and publish no-replace. Permanent regressions must cover interruption before copy, mid-copy, after seal, before publish, a pre-existing quarantine target, and a malicious sealed orphan. No deletion or overwrite is allowed.

p2.finding: capture_process_identity reads each of the five /proc identities once, classifies them, and publishes immediately. It does not perform M2007's required second PID/starttime read after classification and before publication. A synthetic seam whose starttime changes on the sixth read still produced captured_all_five_live=true after exactly five reads.
p2.disposition: After classification, re-read every PID with _proc_record and require the exact pid/starttime/ppid/raw-cmdline-hash/cwd identity still matches before writing or publishing the live receipt. Add an exit/PID-reuse mutation that must reject.

single_next_action: Create one additively numbered source successor that quarantines incomplete import-work no-replace and restarts from the sealed plan, and that re-reads all five process identities immediately before receipt publication; then obtain a fresh different-author source hammer before any process capture or release authoring.
